body: Complete GPT-2 architecture (12L/12H/768D): multi-head causal attention, per-layer GPT2Layer, GELU MLP, weight-tied lm_head. --entropy-stats flag outputs entropy_mean_nats for RSI loop. convert_checkpoint.py fixed for Conv1D transpose. Commit gpt2-alpine-c 8348d1f.
title: gpt2-alpine-c: full transformer parity + entropy source
